name: One God
overview: The Bible clearly teaches the existence of one true God who alone is Lord and Savior, as affirmed in Deuteronomy 6:4 and Isaiah 43:11, emphasizing that there is no other God or savior besides Him. Isaiah 44:6 highlights God's eternal nature as the first and the last, reinforcing His unique sovereignty. In the New Testament, Jesus declares unity with the Father in John 10:30, affirming the oneness of God in the Godhead. James 2:19 acknowledges that even demons recognize the truth of one God, underscoring the foundational biblical truth of monotheism.
